tiers.text: Ask: 'Using the test-code skill, talk me through the five to eight tests this code needs, one line each, with the coverage and what it won't cover. Write the plan under "The agent's plan" in TESTS.md. Don't write the tests yet.'
Run make coverage. Which lines are never run by a test?
Ask the agent to break one thing deliberately and run the tests. Do they notice? Then revert.
